information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA4MzAxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--468a4087b16789d8fa04e058bb93f8f219cb84e7/writing%20contest.%20(2).png) # Welcome to Dare to DR Rizal 2025! # Dare to DR Rizal 2025 is an official WCA competition featuring a wide variety of events, including **3x3, 5x5, 7x7, Pyraminx, Skewb, 4x4 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind**, and highlights **3x3 Fewest Moves** as the main event. This competition also **aims to encourage more cubers to explore and learn Domino Reduction (DR)**—the most advanced method currently used in Fewest Moves solving. * **3x3 Multi-Blind** is limited to **25 competitors,** and it's on a first-come and first-served basis. * **2-Person Mini Guilford** and **Master Magic** will also be held as unofficial events. For more information, please visit the [Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DaretoDRRizal2025#61609-must-read-unofficial-events) tab.
